01 — Brand Overview

About iMaliChat

Mission

iMaliChat empowers users to earn rewards through everyday activities — watching videos, completing surveys, and connecting with friends. Our platform transforms time spent into tangible value through our innovative token-based wallet system.

Brand Personality

  • ✦ Energetic — Vibrant, dynamic, always moving forward
  • ✦ Trustworthy — Secure wallet, real rewards, transparent
  • ✦ Social — Community-driven, friend referrals, MoneyChat
  • ✦ Fun — Playful without being frivolous

Tagline

Earn. Chat. Buy.

Three words that capture the complete user journey — from earning tokens to spending them.

Target Audience

Age Range

20-40

Young professionals & digital natives

Key Features

Video rewards
Survey completion
Friend referrals
MoneyChat transfers

Design Direction

Fun without being frivolous
Lots of color & images
Modern fintech aesthetic
Trustworthy & engaging

02 — Logo System

Logo Components

The iMali Mascot

The iMali mascot is a friendly chat bubble character that embodies our brand's approachable, engaging personality. It comes in two versions for different contexts.

Clean Version

App icon, in-app header, favicon, compact contexts

Bubbles Version

Splash screens, marketing, app store, social media

Primary Logo Lockup

iMaliChat

Horizontal lockup — Primary brand mark for most applications

Stacked Logo Lockup

iMaliChat Earn. Chat. Buy.

Usage

  • ✦ Splash screens
  • ✦ App store listings
  • ✦ Marketing materials
  • ✦ Social media profiles
  • ✦ Presentations

Note

Use the bubbles version for stacked lockup to add visual interest. Tagline is optional.

03 — Logo Usage

Logo on Backgrounds

Approved Background Combinations

iMaliChat
Dark Background — Primary
iMaliChat

On Brand Colors — White text

Do's and Don'ts

✓ Do

  • Use approved color combinations
  • Maintain clear space around logo
  • Use high-resolution assets
  • Keep mascot and wordmark proportional
  • Use gradient wordmark on dark backgrounds
  • Use white wordmark on colored backgrounds

✕ Don't

  • Stretch or distort the logo
  • Change the mascot colors
  • Add effects like drop shadows or glows
  • Place on busy or low-contrast backgrounds
  • Rotate or flip the mascot
  • Separate mascot from wordmark disproportionately

04 — Clear Space & Sizing

Logo Specifications

Clear Space

Maintain a minimum clear space around the logo equal to the height of the "i" in "iMaliChat". This ensures the logo maintains its visual impact and legibility.

iMaliChat Clear Space = "i" height

Minimum Sizes

Application Minimum Width Notes
Horizontal lockup (print) 40mm For business cards, letterheads
Horizontal lockup (digital) 150px For web, app headers
Stacked lockup (print) 30mm Width of mascot
Stacked lockup (digital) 120px Width of mascot
Mascot only 24px Favicon, small icons

In-App Header

For the in-app navigation header, use the compact horizontal lockup with a 32-40px mascot height.

06 — Gradients

Brand Gradients

Primary Logo Gradient

Orange → Pink #FF9900 → #FF328C

Used for: Wordmark, featured elements, marketing headlines

Background Gradient

Deep Blue → Dark (vertical) #142978 → #0C1124

Used for: App background, splash screens

Pink → Purple

Pink → Purple #FF328C → #A011FF

Used for: Alternative wordmark, special promotions

Cyan → Blue

Cyan → Blue #08C2F4 → #0974FF

Used for: Info states, secondary accents, links

Gold → Orange

Gold → Orange #FFB82C → #FF6429

Used for: Rewards, token displays, achievements

07 — Typography

Plus Jakarta Sans

Plus Jakarta Sans is the sole typeface for iMaliChat. It's modern, friendly, highly legible on screens, and works beautifully across all weights. One font family ensures faster load times, easier maintenance, and a cohesive brand experience.

Light iMaliChat — Earn. Chat. Buy. 300
Regular iMaliChat — Earn. Chat. Buy. 400
Medium iMaliChat — Earn. Chat. Buy. 500
SemiBold iMaliChat — Earn. Chat. Buy. 600
Bold iMaliChat — Earn. Chat. Buy. 700
ExtraBold iMaliChat — Earn. Chat. Buy. 800

Font Resources

Google Fonts: fonts.google.com/specimen/Plus+Jakarta+Sans
Include weights: 400, 500, 600, 700, 800

Usage by Weight

Element Weight Use Case
Logo / Wordmark 800 (ExtraBold) Brand mark only
H1 Headlines 700 (Bold) Page titles, hero text
H2 / H3 600 (SemiBold) Section titles, card headers
Token Amounts 700 (Bold) Wallet balance, rewards
Buttons 600 (SemiBold) All button text
Body Text 400 (Regular) Paragraphs, descriptions
Labels / Captions 500 (Medium) Form labels, timestamps

09 — App Icon

App Icon Specifications

Icon Design

App icon uses the clean mascot only — no wordmark

Design Specifications

  • ◆ Use clean mascot (no bubbles)
  • ◆ No additional text or taglines
  • ◆ iOS: 22% corner radius applied automatically
  • ◆ Android: Full bleed, system applies mask
  • ◆ Provide 1024×1024px master file
